title: Duplicating child node of scene instance or inherited scene copies signal binding locked state (yellow), preventing disconnecting until editor restart
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439] ### System information Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (24 threads) - 63.75 GiB memory ### Issue description In those two cases: 1. Creating an inherited scene from a base scene with signals on children and duplicating a child with signals 2. Instantiating a scene in another scene, enabling Editable Children and duplicating a child with signals The resulting child will have the pre-existing signals marked in yellow (not editable), preventing disconnection. This is only a transient bug: restarting the editor will clear the yellow mark and allow edition/disconnection. ### Steps to reproduce ## Setting up the project (already done in MRP, only need to do this once) 1. Create menu.tscn with Menu > Button 2. Add menu.gd script to Menu 3. Connect Button's pressed signal to menu.gd > `_on_button_pressed` method ### Scene instance 1. Create demo.tscn and add instance of menu.tscn 2. Enable Editable Children on that instance ### Inherited scene 1. Create New Inherited Scene from menu.tscn, named menu_inherited.tscn ## Bug repro (you must repeat these steps after every editor restart) ### Scene instance 1. In demo.tscn, duplicate the Button node 2. Check the Signals panel Actual: non-editable, non-disconnectable (yellow) signal binding to `_on_button_pressed` Expected: editable (white) signal binding to `_on_button_pressed` 3. Restart the editor The signal is now editable. ### Inherited scene 1. Open menu_inherited.tscn and duplicate the Button node 2. Check the Signals panel Actual: non-editable, non-disconnectable (yellow) signal binding to `_on_button_pressed` Expected: editable (white) signal binding to `_on_button_pressed` 3. Restart the editor The signal is now editable. ## Notes When copy-pasting a node instead of duplicating it, the signals are not copied at all, so the bug is not visible (not sure if intended or not, I suppose copy-pasting could be done to another location where the signal callback is not reachable and that's the reason why signal bindings are not copied) ## Workaround Same, copy the node and paste it into its parent for a duplicate without the signals at all (you'll have to manually re-add signals you need though) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp-duplicate-inherited-or-instantiated-scene-child-cannot-disconnect-signal.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25995960/mrp-duplicate-inherited-or-instantiated-scene-child-cannot-disconnect-signal.zip)
